policy: Metadata-only cache policy: large expanded or human-oriented replay artifacts are reproducible local caches, never ordinary-CI prerequisites. Their cryptographic metadata remains committed while ordinary CI validates compact evidence, builders, and tests.
history_consequence: O-10 closed for the current tree: the large caches are absent and remain gitignored, but deleting them from a later commit does not remove their blobs from older commits. Existing remote/history size still requires a clean root, explicit history migration, or Git LFS if it must be reduced.
